## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the owning issue(s) with
`Refs #<n>` while acceptance remains open.

## Validation

Record the checks run and their results for this revision, including affected
firmware targets/tool version where relevant. State checks not yet performed.

## Remaining acceptance

Link to the owning issue's outstanding checks, or state that acceptance is
complete / hardware verification is not applicable. Keep procedures and the
live checklist in the issue. Before merging with deferred hardware acceptance,
ensure that issue carries `hw-verification` and observable pass criteria.

## Dependencies

Identify prerequisite PRs or firmware/software compatibility requirements, if
any. Feature PRs target `pre-release`; see
[the workflow policy](https://github.com/slaclab/warm-tdm/blob/pre-release/docs/WORKFLOW.md)
and [release exceptions](https://github.com/slaclab/warm-tdm/blob/pre-release/docs/RELEASE.md).
